summary: Gilat Satellite Networks filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and providing an update on its pending acquisition of Comtech Telecommunications. The registrant (Gilat) is the acquirer in this transaction. The filing details Q2 revenues of $122.7 million (up 17% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of $15.4 million (up 31%). Management reiterated 2026 guidance and stated the Comtech acquisition is on track for a year-end closing, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions. The filing does not disclose the purchase price or premium. Watch for regulatory approval milestones and any risk-arb spreads as the expected close approaches.
